question: Who was the first Indian actress to receive the Padma Shri Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nargis Dutt.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri Award:-**

 
 
• It is the** fourth-highest civilian award **in India, given for distinguished service in various fields including** arts, literature, education, sports, medicine, social work, and public affairs. **
 
• Nargis Dutt was the first Indian actress to receive the Padma Shri Award in 1958.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asha Parekh:-**

 
 
• She​ is also a** Padma Shri awardee**, but she received it in **1992**, much later than Nargis Dutt.
 
 
 
• **Madhubala:-**
 
 
• She** **also known as the **"Marilyn Monroe of Bollywood,"** was a highly acclaimed actress of her time but unfortunately.
 
• She passed away at a young age of 36 due to a** heart condition,** and did not receive the Padma Shri Award.
 
 
 
• **Devika Rani:-**
 
 
• She​ was a pioneer in Indian cinema and was the first actress to receive the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**, which is the highest award in Indian cinema.
